dialogues.speaker: School Principal
dialogues.jp: 「常に初心を忘るることなく勉学に励み……」
dialogues.en:
"And never forget your purpose here; for the pursuit of
knowledge..."
dialogues.text:
"And never forget your purpose here; for the pursuit of
knowledge..."

dialogues.jp:
体育館いっぱいに弛まなく流れるスピーチは、
眠りを誘う絶好のＢＧＭだ。
dialogues.en:
The neverending drone that was the principal's speech in the
gymnasium was the perfect BGM for sleep.
dialogues.text:
The neverending drone that was the principal's speech in the
gymnasium was the perfect BGM for sleep.

dialogues.jp:
｛あくび／欠伸｝をかみ殺すことがメインの行事ってのはつ
まらないこと｛はなは／甚｝だしいな……。
dialogues.en:
My yawn got a few disapproving stares, but what can you
expect from something like this...
dialogues.text:
My yawn got a few disapproving stares, but what can you
expect from something like this...

dialogues.jp: 「あとは、全部以下同文にしてくれ」
dialogues.en: "Make it shorter next time, please..."
dialogues.text: "Make it shorter next time, please..."

dialogues.jp:
卒業式、入学式のときと同じく、長ったらしい
学園長のお話を聞き流しているうちに、いつし
か始業式は終わっていた。
dialogues.en:
Same as graduation, the principal's tremendously long speech
was the hallmark of the school term opening ceremony.
dialogues.text:
Same as graduation, the principal's tremendously long speech
was the hallmark of the school term opening ceremony.

dialogues.jp: 「かったるい……」
dialogues.en: "How troublesome..."
dialogues.text: "How troublesome..."

dialogues.jp:
しっかし、格式ばった学校行事というものはど
うしてこう代わり映えしないものなのか。
dialogues.en:
Maybe there's a reason why they hold a school event like
this long-winded ceremony.
dialogues.text:
Maybe there's a reason why they hold a school event like
this long-winded ceremony.

dialogues.jp:
俺に限らず学生諸君の大半は半｛かくせい／覚醒｝状態で椅子
に座ったまま右に左に揺れていた。
dialogues.en:
The majority of my fellow classmates were half-asleep, their
hands drooped and swaying.
dialogues.text:
The majority of my fellow classmates were half-asleep, their
hands drooped and swaying.

dialogues.jp:
あの退屈比類なきスピーチに耐え切ることが忍
耐力を養う修行だというのなら、確かに役に立っ
てはいるのだが。
dialogues.en:
Maybe this torture is designed to cultivate endurance in us,
to help us in the pursuit of knowledge...
dialogues.text:
Maybe this torture is designed to cultivate endurance in us,
to help us in the pursuit of knowledge...

dialogues.jp:
……まぁ、そんな深い意味もなくただ、学園長
が話し好きなだけだろう。
dialogues.en:
...Well, I shouldn't think too much of it, the principal
probably just likes to talk.
dialogues.text:
...Well, I shouldn't think too much of it, the principal
probably just likes to talk.

dialogues.jp:
（こいつはどうしても思い切った構造改革が必
　要ですなぁ……）
dialogues.en: "(This school event needs a drastic overhaul...)"
dialogues.text: "(This school event needs a drastic overhaul...)"

dialogues.jp:
｛もうろう／朦朧｝とするアタマで｛やくたい／益体｝もないことを考えなが
ら、廊下を歩いていると、俺に負けず劣らずの
んびりした声が背後から聞こえてきた。
dialogues.en:
I walked down the corridor, trying to clear the mist out of
my head. A clear voice came up from behind me.
dialogues.text:
I walked down the corridor, trying to clear the mist out of
my head. A clear voice came up from behind me.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉く〜ん」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-ku~n"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-ku~n"

dialogues.jp: 振り返ると、そこには見慣れた顔が。
dialogues.en: I turned around, and saw a face that's become familiar.
dialogues.text: I turned around, and saw a face that's become familiar.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、萌先輩」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Moe-senpai."
dialogues.text: "Ah, Moe-senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「入学おめでとうございますぅ」
dialogues.en: "Congratulations on your entry to the main school!"
dialogues.text: "Congratulations on your entry to the main school!"

dialogues.jp:
そうだ、これからは萌先輩と一緒の校舎なんだ
よな。
dialogues.en:
That's right, I'd be in the same school building as
Moe-senpai from now on.
dialogues.text:
That's right, I'd be in the same school building as
Moe-senpai from now on.

dialogues.jp:
「萌先輩も在校生音楽部の演奏、ご苦労さまで
　した」
dialogues.en:
"Thank you. Your performance during the entrance ceremony
was much appreciated as well."
dialogues.text:
"Thank you. Your performance during the entrance ceremony
was much appreciated as well."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あはは………………ちょ〜っと失敗しちゃい
　ましたけどね」
dialogues.en: "Ahahaha...... I kinda messed up though."
dialogues.text: "Ahahaha...... I kinda messed up though."

dialogues.jp: ぽけぽけっと間延びした声で笑う。
dialogues.en: She laughed in her seeemingly slow tone.
dialogues.text: She laughed in her seeemingly slow tone.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあまた今度………………ふあぁ」
dialogues.en: "I'd see you another time..... yaaawn."
dialogues.text: "I'd see you another time..... yaaawn."

dialogues.jp: 先輩は盛大な｛あくび／欠伸｝をしながら俺に手を振った。
dialogues.en:
Moe-senpai released a big yawn, waving at me as she turned
around.
dialogues.text:
Moe-senpai released a big yawn, waving at me as she turned
around.

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩も眠そうだったな。
dialogues.en: I bet she slept through it too.
dialogues.text: I bet she slept through it too.

dialogues.jp: （まあ、あの人のはいつものことか）
dialogues.en: "(Oh well, she's always like that anyway.)"
dialogues.text: "(Oh well, she's always like that anyway.)"

dialogues.jp: そう考えて、俺はちょっと笑った。
dialogues.en: I laughed to myself as I thought about her.
dialogues.text: I laughed to myself as I thought about her.

dialogues.jp: 新しい教室。新しいクラスメイト。
dialogues.en: A new classroom. New classmates.
dialogues.text: A new classroom. New classmates.

dialogues.jp:
心機一転、初々しい気持ちでスタートラインに
立てるはず、だったのだが――。
dialogues.en: This should be a fresh beginning, the starting line. Yet...
dialogues.text: This should be a fresh beginning, the starting line. Yet...

dialogues.jp: 「……腐れ縁、とはこのことか」
dialogues.en: "...Murphy's Law just had to take effect."
dialogues.text: "...Murphy's Law just had to take effect."

dialogues.jp:
俺は目の前に立つ男の姿に｛えいたん／詠歎｝の溜息を漏らし
た。
dialogues.en: I moaned, to the man in front of me.
dialogues.text: I moaned, to the man in front of me.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ふっ、そう言うな。俺達は赤い糸でくくられ
　ているのだ」
dialogues.en:
"Hm, don't say that. After all, we are tied by the threads
of fate."
dialogues.text:
"Hm, don't say that. After all, we are tied by the threads
of fate."

dialogues.jp:
……はぁ。俺はコイツの魔手から逃れられぬ運
命にあるのだろうか。
dialogues.en: ...Sigh. Looks like there's no escaping his evil influence.
dialogues.text: ...Sigh. Looks like there's no escaping his evil influence.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「結ばれている、だろ？」
dialogues.en: "Bonded together, you mean?"
dialogues.text: "Bonded together, you mean?"

dialogues.jp:
やはり同じクラスになった悪友その２が訂正す
る。
dialogues.en:
Correction: Kudou has to be here for Murphy's law to truly
be in effect.
dialogues.text:
Correction: Kudou has to be here for Murphy's law to truly
be in effect.

dialogues.jp: 「どっちにしろ願い下げだ」
dialogues.en: "If I could cancel it, I would."
dialogues.text: "If I could cancel it, I would."

dialogues.jp:
工藤はともかく、杉並とは赤い糸どころか、荷
造り紐でもご遠慮願いたい。
dialogues.en:
Disregarding Kudou, there's no person alive who'd want
anything to do with Suginami.
dialogues.text:
Disregarding Kudou, there's no person alive who'd want
anything to do with Suginami.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、結局またこいつらと一緒とは……なん
か、進級した気分が全然湧いてこない。
dialogues.en:
Graduating to the main school, yet still stuck with these
two... it's like there's no difference at all.
dialogues.text:
Graduating to the main school, yet still stuck with these
two... it's like there's no difference at all.

dialogues.jp:
（唯一の潤いは……ことりがいることぐらいか
　な）
dialogues.en:
"(Thankfully there's one saving grace... Kotori's in this
class too.)"
dialogues.text:
"(Thankfully there's one saving grace... Kotori's in this
class too.)"

dialogues.jp:
彼女の名をクラス割りに見つけて、どれほど救
われた気分になったことか。
dialogues.en:
When I saw her name on the class list, my hope for the
future brightened a little.
dialogues.text:
When I saw her name on the class list, my hope for the
future brightened a little.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「良かったね工藤君、一緒のクラスになれて」
dialogues.en:
"Isn't it great, Kudou-kun? We're in the same class this
time."
dialogues.text:
"Isn't it great, Kudou-kun? We're in the same class this
time."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「うん。これからもよろしく、ことり」
dialogues.en: "Yeah. Let's work hard, Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Yeah. Let's work hard, Kotori."

dialogues.jp:
しかし、ことりはなにやら親しげに工藤と話し
ていた。なんだ、微妙に面白くないぞ。
dialogues.en:
Yet, she instead started talking with Kudou as if they've
been friends forever. Not very subtle, are they?
dialogues.text:
Yet, she instead started talking with Kudou as if they've
been friends forever. Not very subtle, are they?

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「むぅ？　こちらで既に出来上がっているカッ
　プル発見か」
dialogues.en: "Mm? I spy a couple in the making."
dialogues.text: "Mm? I spy a couple in the making."

dialogues.jp:
そんな二人の様子に、早速、杉並が茶々を入れ
る。
dialogues.en:
Seeing the two of them, Suginami immediately disrupted their
conversation.
dialogues.text:
Seeing the two of them, Suginami immediately disrupted their
conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「やだ杉並君、何言ってるのよ」
dialogues.en: "That's not true, Suginami! Don't say weird things."
dialogues.text: "That's not true, Suginami! Don't say weird things."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうだ！　誤解だよ、俺とことりは……」
dialogues.en: "R, right! You're just misunderstanding us..."
dialogues.text: "R, right! You're just misunderstanding us..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「照れるな照れるな。｛ふしょうふずい／夫唱婦随｝か、良いことじゃ
　ないか。なぁ朝倉ぁ」
dialogues.en:
"No need to be embarassed. Having a subservient wife is
always a bonus. Isn't it, Asakura?"
dialogues.text:
"No need to be embarassed. Having a subservient wife is
always a bonus. Isn't it, Asakura?"

dialogues.jp:
かっかっと笑いながら、なれなれしく俺の肩を
叩く杉並。
dialogues.en: Suginami patted my shoulder, grinning.
dialogues.text: Suginami patted my shoulder, grinning.

dialogues.jp: 「だーから、俺に振るなっての！」
dialogues.en: "Don't act as if you know me, geez!"
dialogues.text: "Don't act as if you know me, geez!"

dialogues.jp:
その手をぺしぺしと振り払う。コイツと一緒に
されては堪らない。
dialogues.en: I shook off his hand. Being with this idiot is unbearable.
dialogues.text: I shook off his hand. Being with this idiot is unbearable.

dialogues.speaker: Tahata
dialogues.jp: 「……類は友を呼ぶ」
dialogues.en: "...Close as usual."
dialogues.text: "...Close as usual."

dialogues.jp:
失礼なつぶやきに目を向けると、そこにもうひ
とり知った顔があった。
dialogues.en:
Tracing the barely audible mutter, my eyes fell onto yet
another face I knew.
dialogues.text:
Tracing the barely audible mutter, my eyes fell onto yet
another face I knew.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、田端お前も同じクラスだったのか？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Tahata, you're in the same class as well?
dialogues.text: "Ah, Tahata, you're in the same class as well?

dialogues.jp:
こくり、と頷く。うーむ。存在感が薄いので見
落としていたが、なんか悪いことをしたような
気分だな。
dialogues.en:
A quick nod was all the answer he gave. His silence always
gives me the impression of evilness.
dialogues.text:
A quick nod was all the answer he gave. His silence always
gives me the impression of evilness.

dialogues.jp: 心なしか、元気がないようにも見えるが――。
dialogues.en: Like he has no heart, and has never been happy...
dialogues.text: Like he has no heart, and has never been happy...

dialogues.jp:
ま、コイツのテンションは、もとからこんなも
んか。
dialogues.en:
But, his tension can probably be explained by what's going
on now.
dialogues.text:
But, his tension can probably be explained by what's going
on now.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「フフフフ…………やはり、我らチームの絆は
　堅い！　これからも共に学園生活を送ろうで
　はないか！」
dialogues.en:
"Fufufufu.... indeed, the bonds of our team are strong! We'd
always live our school life together!"
dialogues.text:
"Fufufufu.... indeed, the bonds of our team are strong! We'd
always live our school life together!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「お、俺を数に入れないでくれっ」
dialogues.en: "D, don't count me in that."
dialogues.text: "D, don't count me in that."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……お前とチームなんて組んだ覚えはない」
dialogues.en: "...I don't recall ever being part of a team with you."
dialogues.text: "...I don't recall ever being part of a team with you."

dialogues.speaker: Suignami
dialogues.jp: 「まあまあ、細かいことはいいではないか」
dialogues.en: "Pish posh, that's just an insignifcant detail."
dialogues.text: "Pish posh, that's just an insignifcant detail."

dialogues.speaker: Asakura & Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「よくない！！！！」
dialogues.en: "No it's not!!!!"
dialogues.text: "No it's not!!!!"

dialogues.jp: むしろ細かくない。
dialogues.en: It'd better not be...
dialogues.text: It'd better not be...

dialogues.jp:
田端がだめだこりゃ、というように肩をすくめ
て見せる。
dialogues.en:
Tahata shrugged his shoulders, saying that this was a
hopeless situation.
dialogues.text:
Tahata shrugged his shoulders, saying that this was a
hopeless situation.

dialogues.jp:
声を合わせた俺達を見て、遠くからことりが拍
手を贈った。
dialogues.en: From afar, Kotori applauded us.
dialogues.text: From afar, Kotori applauded us.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「わ、すごーい！　息ピッタリだね、みんな」
dialogues.en: "Wah, amazing! Your voices were in perfect synchronization!"
dialogues.text: "Wah, amazing! Your voices were in perfect synchronization!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そこ、人ごとだと思って拍手しない！」
dialogues.en:
"That's nothing for people to be clapping their hands
about!"
dialogues.text:
"That's nothing for people to be clapping their hands
about!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あはははははははっ」
dialogues.en: "Ahahahaha."
dialogues.text: "Ahahahaha."

dialogues.jp:
はぁ、これからまた騒がしい毎日が始まるのか。
……まったくもってやれやれだ。
dialogues.en:
Haah, and so began the first of several noisy school days.
...Tiresome and troublesome.
dialogues.text:
Haah, and so began the first of several noisy school days.
...Tiresome and troublesome.

dialogues.jp: ◆変わらぬ日々◆
dialogues.en: ◆Unchanging Days◆
dialogues.text: ◆Unchanging Days◆

dialogues.jp: 長ったらしい始業式も終った。
dialogues.en: The long opening ceremony came to an end.
dialogues.text: The long opening ceremony came to an end.

dialogues.jp:
心機一転新しい気持ちで教室のドアを開けた俺
だが、杉並、工藤との腐れ縁は相変わらずだっ
た。
dialogues.en:
As I opened the door to a change in my life, I was still
forcibly linked to Kudou and Suginami, as usual.
dialogues.text:
As I opened the door to a change in my life, I was still
forcibly linked to Kudou and Suginami, as usual.

dialogues.jp:
唯一の救いはことりと同じクラスになった事だ
けだな……。
dialogues.en:
The only saving grace was that Kotori was in the same class
as well...
dialogues.text:
The only saving grace was that Kotori was in the same class
as well...
